Name: John Mangin, Board of Standard and Appeals
Title: RESOLUTION APPROVING THE APPOINTMENT BY THE MAYOR OF JOHN MANGIN AS THE CHAIR OF THE NEW YORK CITY BOARD OF STANDARDS AND APPEALS.
BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

History.Description: This Resolution was Approved by Committee
History.BodyName: Committee on Rules, Privileges, Elections, Standards and Ethics

Text:
RESOLVED, Pursuant to Section 31 of the New York City Charter, the Council hereby approves the appointment by the Mayor of John Mangin as the Chair of the New York City Board of Standards and Appeals to serve the remainder of a six-year term that will expire on October 6, 2027.


COUPLED ON GO
